prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent character orientation sprite atlas for an RPG virtual tabletop.
Input image 1: character identity and style reference, not a scene.
Primary request: create one clean 4-column by 2-row sprite atlas, exactly eight full-body standing resting views of the same blond pointed-ear elf mage wearing a royal-blue robe with gold embroidered trim, cream underlayers, belt and brown boots. Match the fine pixel-edged illustrated RPG style and compact proportions of the reference. These are NOT eight different characters. Same character design and height in every cell.
Layout row 1, left to right: N (exact rear view, face not visible), NE (rear three-quarter facing upper-right, mostly back), E (right side profile, nose pointing right), SE (front three-quarter facing lower-right).
Layout row 2, left to right: S (exact front view), SW (front three-quarter facing lower-left), W (left side profile, nose pointing left), NW (rear three-quarter facing upper-left, mostly back).
The head, shoulders, torso, feet and held equipment all turn consistently with each view. Neutral resting pose, both feet planted; no running, attack, casting or walking motion.
Composition: square canvas with a strict regular 4x2 grid. Full body fits its cell, all poses same physical scale, centered within each cell with feet on a consistent bottom baseline, at least 12% empty margins so wings or equipment never cross a cell edge. Fixed gentle elevated game camera angle. Clear crisp silhouettes and detailed color matching reference.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no scenery, no floor, no ground shadow, no contact oval, no grey or checkerboard painted background. No grid lines, letters, labels, icons, borders, text or watermark. Do not change outfit, anatomy, age, species, colors or equipment.
